truthReview: 2026-10-04: the pin is moved and merged. The bundle rebuilt from 944a57a1e is byte-identical to upstream's; the notices are regenerated for the changed lock (45 packages, Tiptap 3.31.4, all copied from the installed packages); a packaged runtime at the commit is built on this Mac. The first local matrix on the new pin was 14 of 20. Two causes, neither an editor regression: (1) upstream separated its public port from its listen port, so a release handed out addresses on port 80 and uploaded pictures could not be fetched; the launcher now passes PHX_PORT, which turned images, link preview and table widths green; (2) gaps, subsup and tablehead fail identically on this Mac with the old pin, because those tests press Control where macOS uses Command; they are green on Linux. On GitHub's Linux runner the branch is 20 of 20 rows green, row 14 included (https://github.com/FRIKKern/barkdown/actions/runs/37201636752). On this Mac the app's whole test chain passes on the branch with the new runtime, and the visual run differs from the approved baseline in two frames only, both by the editor bundle's sha1 line in Settings. Not verified: the three Control-key rows on macOS (a test limitation that predates this cycle); the new runtime inside the packaged app until the nightly's own tours run; Windows.
screenshotReview: The visual run on the upgraded editor differs beyond tolerance in two frames, settings: barkpark and settings: library-switch, both by the bundle's sha1 line (reviewed and approved on the branch).
